object.attr: The app has no user profile in version 1, so a 70 kg body mass is assumed. The value is an estimate. The metabolic equivalent depends on the activity type chosen at Start. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: Once per second in the recording state, the app shall set the calories to the metabolic equivalent (PACE-SRS-60, PACE-SRS-61) times 3.5 times 70 kg times elapsed minutes divided by 200, rounded to whole kcal.
